note: Errata 182: every quoted line in the source documents that /content does not carry (tools/check-written-vs-built.mjs), grouped with the reason. GAP groups were reported to Tyler on 2026-11-08 and wait on his ruling; a line comes off this list when it is built. Lines under four words are below the check's bar, so two short gaps it cannot see are named here by hand: Hob's running lines ('It'll rain.', 'That's not yours.', 'Wouldn't stand there.', 'You're the piano man.') and Ozymandia's '...It's loud here.'
